description: This file manages connected calendars, ensuring no conflicts with delegation credentials, handling creation and updates of destination calendars, and fetching user calendar data with synchronization logic.

classes.name: UserWithCalendars
classes.description: Type representing a user with associated calendars, selected calendars, and destination calendar.

methods.name: _ensureNoConflictingNonDelegatedConnectedCalendar
methods.description: Filters connected calendars to prevent conflicts when delegation credentials are involved, ensuring only the appropriate calendar is shown.

methods.name: handleNoConnectedCalendars
methods.description: Deletes the destination calendar if no connected calendars are found for the user.

methods.name: handleNoDestinationCalendar
methods.description: Creates a default destination calendar when none exists, selecting the primary connected calendar.

methods.name: handleDestinationCalendarNotInConnectedCalendars
methods.description: Updates the destination calendar if it is not present in the list of connected calendars.

methods.name: findMatchingCalendar
methods.description: Finds a calendar in the connected calendars that matches the destination calendar.

methods.name: ensureSelectedCalendarIsInDb
methods.description: Upserts the selected calendar record in the database.

methods.name: getSelectedCalendars
methods.description: Retrieves the relevant selected calendars based on event type.

methods.name: getConnectedDestinationCalendarsAndEnsureDefaultsInDb
methods.description: Main function to fetch user calendars, handle synchronization, and ensure default calendars are set.
